body.purpose: Keeps forms, tables, and navigation familiar.

label.purpose: Makes form meaning easy to scan.

shadows.name: login-panel
shadows.purpose: Separates the sign-in panel from the pale background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances checkout or saves a valid form.
components.css: .ds-button { background: #247351; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; font: 600 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-button:hover { background: #1e6244; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #174f38; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button:active { background: #174f38; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: A familiar editable field with visible focus and error states.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Search by name or SKU" placeholder="Search by name or SKU">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #23312b; border: 1px solid #cbd6ce; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #26775c; outline: 2px solid rgba(38, 119, 92, 0.13); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b33535; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Keeps module changes consistent and the active destination visible.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; background: transparent; color: #dae5dd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 13px; font: 600 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #2b4338; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav[aria-current='page'] { background: #315343; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b4d6c2; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface keeps sale math and stock status easy to scan during everyday shop work. A leaf-green accent marks actions and active navigation while a bright, quiet work surface keeps tables and form values legible. The same shell and control language carries across checkout, product maintenance, stock movements, receipts, reports, and settings.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet light workspace framed by a deep green navigation rail.
Money and quantity values use consistent, clearly grouped numerals.
Errors, warnings, disabled fields, and success messages have distinct states.
Familiar JavaFX controls support keyboard-first operation.

rules.name: The Counter Rule
rules.body: Let checkout totals and available stock carry the strongest emphasis on the POS screen.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use accent color to identify an action or a state, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Working Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep labels and table data compact; reserve the largest type for the current screen heading and key totals.

rules.name: The Flow Rule
rules.body: Keep the next action beside the data it changes.

dos: Do keep field errors directly beside the field that needs correction.
Do use the primary green for the action that advances the current task.
Do retain a grey treatment for read-only values.
donts: Don't use accent colors to decorate inactive panels.
Don't replace standard controls with custom interactions that slow checkout.
Don't make historical receipt data editable.
